body: The fallback for a missing or unreadable `title` on `#acrPopover` does not read the element's text content as TS-AMZ-ITEM-AIR-001 says. `elementContentByID` cuts the content at the first closing tag with the same name and does not handle nesting. Amazon's `#acrPopover` is a `` with nested ``s (see the `rating-fr.html` fixture: `4,54,5 sur 5 étoiles`). So without the title, the fallback only gets `4,5`, `starsPattern` does not match, and the rating is recorded as absent. The test case 'rating in the text only' passes only because its `a-icon-alt` span is the first child. Suggested fix: when the title does not match, run `starsPattern` on the text of the page slice from the `acrPopover` opening tag to the `acrCustomerReviewText` element (or to a bounded length), or read the `a-icon-alt` text inside that slice. Add a case with the fixture markup without its `title` attribute.

This PR implements issue #305, but after merge the main specification still describes it as future work. The non-goals list still has 'AI reviews of Amazon items (being added by issue #305 …)', and the item details paragraph (line 176) says 'Amazon items will too once issue #305 is implemented'. Suggested fix: remove the Amazon AI review non-goal, and say in the details page paragraph that Amazon items show the purchase goal and their AI review section (see 5.6a).
